title: Universal Type-I Parametric Stack + Inference Compiler

inference_policy.numeric: Allowed only when every required geometry/material/process/environment input is attributable to a source or measurement and the governing model is valid for that domain.
inference_policy.symbolic: Required when the equation is known but one or more required inputs are unresolved.
inference_policy.hold: HOLD required when model validity, directional compatibility, process damage, packing/resolution, authority, safety or evidence is unresolved.
inference_policy.uncertainty: Carry source, geometry, process and metrology uncertainty. Use RSS only for independent linear terms; use covariance/nonlinear propagation otherwise.

directional_rule: X→Y is allowed only when Y does not violate X's damage envelope and the required interface/interlayer, voxel/spacing constraint and environment transitions are present. X→Y never implies Y→X.

primitive_basis.network: distributed R + contact R + parasitic L/C

primitive_basis.law: exact device model; no geometry-only semiconductor inference
J≈-D∇c where valid; seal mechanics source-bound

source_inputs.epsilon_r_basis: DuPont Kapton HN at 1 kHz from current source-bound candidate record

inference_fixtures.source_ref: CGXI-P2-C-001 / DuPont Kapton HN 25 um candidate

source_inputs.epsilon_r_basis: DuPont Kapton HN typical dielectric constant at 1 kHz from current source-bound record

non_claims: not permission to infer absent properties
advanced silicon, MEMS, precision optoelectronics and certified protection remain seed/hybrid unless separately qualified

volumetric_policy.role: Equation/constitutive kernels define domain physics; volumetric kernels define topology, geometry, boundaries, embedding/orientation and matrix/field/network form.
volumetric_policy.canonical_closed_form: Use only when the exact topology and governing assumptions are attributable and valid.
volumetric_policy.general_3d: Use Maxwell capacitance matrices, inductance matrices, distributed R'L'G'C', sparse thermal/mechanical/fluid networks or other domain field models rather than forcing a simpler geometry law.
volumetric_policy.revision_rule: Any consequential geometry/material/process/boundary revision invalidates stale topology-specific numeric inference or field matrices.
volumetric_policy.coupling_rule: Only declared interfaces/couplings enter the sparse 4D assembly. Unsupported terms remain HOLD.

seed_field_policy.intent_vs_geometry: Schematic/netlist connectivity is design intent. The 3D as-built region/seed geometry defines parasitic and mutual electrical, EM, thermal and mechanical coupling.
seed_field_policy.mutual_rule: SG-N retains off-diagonal mutual C/L/thermal/mechanical/RF terms when consequential; omission requires sensitivity/evidence.
seed_field_policy.radiative_rule: RF electromagnetic radiation, optical propagation, thermal radiation and ionizing-radiation transport are separate model families and are never collapsed into one generic radiation equation.
seed_field_policy.smart_rule: Smart embedded capability requires attributable sensed state, deterministic control/safe-state and output/actuator relation. Geometry alone does not imply intelligence.

sequence: print/form conductor and resistor witness features on compatible support
form 10x10 mm parallel-plate capacitor overlap across 25 um HN candidate only if process route preserves dielectric
candidate_witness_stacks.resistor_rule: For target R, required squares N=R_target/R_sheet. Numeric geometry remains HOLD until exact cured sheet-resistance blend/lot/process is bound.
candidate_witness_stacks.inductor_rule: L/R/Q remain SYMBOLIC until exact conductor geometry, thickness/state, return environment and measurement/field model are bound.

candidate_witness_stacks.rule: Reuse the SG-0 printed/passive field-management stack around one exact active/certified/precision seed. Package pads and body become explicit conductor, capacitance, inductance, thermal and mechanical boundary nodes.
candidate_witness_stacks.gate: Select exact seed only after function, voltage/current, I/O, thermal, package, service and safety envelope are declared. No placeholder seed may be treated as capability.

radiative_transport_policy.graph: source -> propagation/transport region -> interfaces -> coupling/scatter/absorption -> receiver/load -> loss/storage -> witness
radiative_transport_policy.seed_rule: SG-0/SG-1/SG-N changes discrete source/receiver population, not the underlying physics or evidence rules.
radiative_transport_policy.regime_rule: Electrostatic, magnetoquasistatic, EM near-field, EM far-field, optical, thermal radiation, acoustic, fluid, species, ionic/electrochemical, ionizing and inertial regimes remain distinct.
radiative_transport_policy.energy_rule: Passive regions must close an input/stored/dissipated/exported energy balance within declared uncertainty; active gain requires an attributable source.
radiative_transport_policy.revision_rule: Consequential geometry/material/process/boundary or seed revision invalidates stale field/mutual matrices and requires solve/readback refresh.
